rows.summary: Edge-case layer: planning-only claims conflict with implementation
rows.evidence: The Spec Change Log explicitly scopes planning-only wording and the prior ready-for-dev result to the completed earlier invocation; this user dispatch resumes runtime implementation. A requested fix to this build's spec is also rejected by the review rules.

rows.summary: Intent auditor: local graph controls do not establish hosted runner behavior
rows.evidence: Local and hosted evidence are explicitly separated. Executed composite/graph/reporter controls prove local orchestration; the separately planned pinned hosted probe supplies the hosted observation or exact execution blocker before finalization.

rows.summary: Intent auditor: publisher controls replace destination/login actions
rows.evidence: The results identify these as local simulations and retain separate story 3-4 hosted package/image qualification. No new hosted publication is claimed or authorized by the recovery probe.

rows.summary: Intent auditor: actual hosted complete-mode evidence is still pending
rows.evidence: Pinned hosted run 43035532396 executed the actual reusable graph at runtime 1713722053b0c1944ee2f9dad5c09c56a08951a6. The effective switch was invalid; exact diagnostics, actual publish=false, successful current-dispatch CodeQL and the sole failed outcome are retained. Positive handoff is explicitly unverified; temporary controls are removed.

rows.summary: Intent auditor: literal prior planning-only reading diverges from runtime
rows.evidence: The ready-for-dev dispatch and explicit implementation-continuation change log resolve this temporal reading; original planning history is preserved as history.

rows.summary: Intent auditor: textual diff does not demonstrate commit/push
rows.evidence: The exact messages passed pinned commitlint. Runtime 1713722053b0c1944ee2f9dad5c09c56a08951a6 and probe 962440af99c1f12d91eec192715210c83a728344 were committed/pushed and their full remote revisions read back. Final cleanup delivery and its full revision are recorded in the canonical story; CiCd only stages the story and pushed gitlink.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: enabled-but-skipped security gates can permit stale mutation before reporter failure
rows.evidence: Parent reproduced both configured CodeQL and nightly skips executing draft before failed reporting. The draft guard now accepts skipped gates only when resolve explicitly disables them; both graph regressions assert zero draft mutation.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: draft changes during artifact download can escape into publish=true
rows.evidence: Parent reproduced a published draft with publish=true after one release GET. Recovery now revalidates the unchanged live selected draft after artifact authentication; body-change and publication regressions assert no handoff or writes.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: external mutation after the final GET could race unconditional DELETE
rows.evidence: The implementation performs the required immediate live revalidation and standard callers serialize release runs. Real GitHub behavior for an out-of-band editor/publisher in this final interval was not destructively qualified; the retained resources must remain untouched. Settle with an authorized disposable two-actor qualification and a supported serialization/atomicity decision. If true, medium impact; unverified.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: per-destination deadlines can exhaust the overall job budget
rows.evidence: Every network operation and the job are bounded; timeout leaves the draft intact and the reporter still emits failed. The remaining harm is a late/generic diagnostic for many unusually slow destinations. A propagated global budget adds branches and parameters for a rare low-impact case, beyond a direct correction.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: stale reporting accepts omitted artifact/draft output fields
rows.evidence: The reproduction deletes fields from synthetic needs after a successful draft. The trusted adapter emits all validated eight identity fields only after confirmed DELETE; a genuine successful stale invocation with those fields missing is not reachable. Stale ownership is correctly bound to complete mode, successful draft, publish=false, source/version and matching own no-op output; no publisher authorization is granted.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: mixed inventory needs one more compound HTTP adapter test
rows.evidence: Actual adapter/graph tests verify pull-secret and identity mappings, mixed inventory orchestration checks every production decision seam, and real HTTP NuGet/registry tests verify exact HEAD/status/auth behavior. Every matrix row ran and passed. No additional unguarded behavior or missing contract coverage was demonstrated by requiring all seams in one fixture.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: available recovery lacked a composed original OCI payload regression
rows.evidence: Added an original multi-platform OCI artifact through recovery's real inventory validator and handoff, plus container-trailer disagreement refusal. Existing publisher OCI HTTP/copy controls continue to verify the complete graph and retry.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: verification records were not bound to tested runtime source
rows.evidence: Final records bind full HEAD and SHA-256 hashes for 33 runtime/test files through one content-addressed manifest, and assert that source stayed unchanged during every final check. Raw and compact log hashes are preserved separately.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: preflight/403 alone is not hosted complete-mode evidence
rows.evidence: Completed pinned hosted run 43035532396 under the unchanged switch. Resolve failed exactly HEXALITH_RELEASE_PUBLISH_ENABLED must be exactly true or false; CodeQL passed, version/build/draft skipped, publish=false and exactly one schema-valid failed outcome were observed. This is the retained positive-verification blocker, with unchanged draft/body/source/tag and removed temporary controls.

rows.summary: Blind hunter: prior planning result appears to be current terminal status
rows.evidence: The previous result is preserved as explicit planning history; the workflow writes the current implementation result and terminal status during normal finalization. The read-only intent contract remains unchanged; editing the spec as a review fix is rejected.
